description: US election season. Political sensitivity elevated broadly; ordinary brand language is being read as coded positioning. Fictional headlines attributed to invented outlets.

items.headline: Six weeks out, brands quietly pause campaigns with any civic framing
Apparel maker's 'freedom' tagline is claimed by both sides within a day
Boycott hashtags trend against two retailers over unrelated donation records
Survey: most consumers now assume brand messaging carries a political stance
Marketing bodies issue neutrality guidance for the closing weeks of the campaign

active_controversies: Neutral-sounding taglines are being claimed as endorsements by rival camps
Two retailers facing boycott campaigns over historical donation records
Patriotic and civic imagery is being read as partisan signalling by default
